# Further explanation

When making a POST request to our AWS S3 bucket (the url returned in step 2), include the attributes from the body in the POST body to S3. Upload the file to the S3 bucket as **FormData**.

Full Documentation available here: [https://api.formalize.com/docs](https://api.formalize.com/docs)
